source: Jakeschincariol/youtube-agent-skill yt-script hooks.json (YT-01..21, source order); pairing field added (craft, ours)
evidence: craft; example numbers in the source are illustrative, never facts
rules: Confirm the title in the first sentence ('a hook that ignores its own title is why people leave at 0:08').
If an artifact is promised, show it inside 20 s.
Never open with who you are.
Match the opener to the title formula (pairing field).
Examples show shape only; never reuse their numbers.

hooks.name: The Statistic
hooks.template: {Number the viewer did not know}, said flat. {Consequence}.
hooks.example: 97% of the people who start a channel quit before video 30. Here is what the other 3% do differently.
hooks.pairing: title: '{N}% of {group} {fact}'; thumb: the number alone

hooks.name: Someone Else's Result
hooks.example: This channel went from 400 subscribers to 200,000 in seven months on one format. I mapped it.
hooks.trap: Inventing it; if you cannot name it, use another formula.
hooks.pairing: title: '{Name} went from {A} to {B}'; thumb: before -> after figure

hooks.name: The Mistake
hooks.template: {Error the viewer is making now}. {It is not the obvious cause}.
hooks.example: Your first 30 seconds are why nobody finishes your videos. It is not the topic.
hooks.trap: Must be common and checkable in 1 s.
hooks.pairing: title: 'Why your {thing} {fails}'; thumb: the wrong thing, crossed out

hooks.name: Contrarian Flip
hooks.template: {Accepted advice}. Then reject it with evidence.
hooks.example: Everyone says post daily. I posted once a week for a year and tripled the channel.
hooks.trap: Evidence must arrive within the next 15 s.
hooks.pairing: title: '{Advice} is wrong'; thumb: the advice, struck through

hooks.name: The Reveal
hooks.template: Promise a specific thing shown on screen, then show it.
hooks.example: I am going to show you the exact prompt, on screen, that wrote this video.
hooks.pairing: title: 'The exact {artifact} that {outcome}'; thumb: the artifact

hooks.name: The Superlative
hooks.example: This is the fastest way to turn one long video into thirty Shorts.
hooks.trap: Earn it by naming what it beat.
hooks.pairing: title: 'The fastest way to {outcome}'; thumb: the outcome, 2-3 words

hooks.name: The Clock
hooks.template: In the next {N} minutes you will have {payoff}.
hooks.example: In the next six minutes you will have a working title, thumbnail and script.
hooks.pairing: title: '{Outcome} in {N} minutes'; thumb: the clock figure

hooks.name: I Tried It
hooks.example: I let an AI run my channel for 30 days. I did not touch the uploads.
hooks.pairing: title: 'I {did X} for {N} days'; thumb: face + the result

hooks.name: The Question
hooks.example: Why do your videos die at 30 seconds when the topic is fine?
hooks.best_for: search; pull the wording from comments
hooks.pairing: title: the query verbatim; thumb: the answer in 2-3 words

hooks.name: The Before-After
hooks.example: This was my thumbnail. This is my thumbnail now. Same video, four times the click-through.
hooks.pairing: title: '{A} -> {B}: what changed'; thumb: split before/after

hooks.name: The Teardown
hooks.template: Take a real thing apart: name what and how many.
hooks.example: I pulled the nine most-viewed AI videos of the month and broke down what the titles share.
hooks.pairing: title: 'I analysed {N} {things}: {finding}'; thumb: the count

hooks.name: The Stack
hooks.example: Claude plus your YouTube Studio export gives you next week's upload schedule in one prompt.
hooks.trap: Both must be nameable and the outcome must need both.
hooks.pairing: title: '{A} + {B} = {outcome}'; thumb: two logos

hooks.name: The Warning
hooks.template: {Cost the viewer is about to pay}.
hooks.example: Do not upload another video until you check this one setting.
hooks.pairing: title: 'Don't {action} until you {check}'; thumb: warning word

hooks.name: The List
hooks.example: Seven things I would do differently if I started a channel in 2026.
hooks.trap: Items that do not differ in kind.
hooks.pairing: title: '{N} {things} {outcome}'; thumb: the number

hooks.name: The Receipt
hooks.example: This is the analytics page. This video did 40% of the channel's watch time. Here is why.
hooks.pairing: title: 'This {artifact} {result}'; thumb: the artifact

hooks.name: The Insider
hooks.template: Information from inside a system that almost nobody uses.
hooks.example: YouTube tells you which videos are underperforming. Almost nobody opens the report.
hooks.pairing: title: 'The hidden {report} that {outcome}'; thumb: the setting

hooks.name: The Impossible
hooks.example: You can write, title, thumbnail and schedule a week of videos without opening a single editor.
hooks.pairing: title: '{Outcome} without {expected tool}'; thumb: the missing thing, crossed out

hooks.name: The Comparison
hooks.example: I wrote the same video three ways. One of them held 62% and the other two did not.
hooks.trap: Say the loser; no loser = advert.
hooks.pairing: title: '{A} vs {B}: {verdict}'; thumb: both, winner marked

hooks.name: The Origin
hooks.example: Every video on this channel starts in the same 12-line file. Here it is.
hooks.pairing: title: 'The {file} behind every {thing}'; thumb: the file

hooks.name: The Deadline
hooks.example: The old description format stops mattering this month. Here is what replaces it.
hooks.trap: Fastest trust loss if the date is not real.
hooks.pairing: title: '{Thing} changes {date}: what to do'; thumb: the date

hooks.name: The Direct Address
hooks.template: Name the exact viewer in the first six words.
hooks.example: If you have under a thousand subscribers, this is the only video you need this week.
hooks.trap: A broad viewer description; narrow beats broad.
hooks.pairing: title: 'If you {situation}, {promise}'; thumb: the situation in 3 words
